title: pq-agent-batch signed action v1
description: One ML-DSA-65 signed order, as produced by `pqagent sign` and accepted by the reference batcher. The signature covers `message` (133 bytes) = ORDER_TAG_V2 | chainId u64 | settlement | agentId u32 | nonce u64 | expiry u32 | modelHash | orderBytes, ORDER_TAG_V2 = keccak256("EmpowerTours.AgentOrder.v2"). Consumers MUST re-derive orderBytes and message from the other fields and check sha256(publicKey) == pkHash before trusting them.

nonce.description: must exceed the agent's on-chain lastNonce; a batch takes consecutive nonces per agent

expiry.description: unix seconds; all orders of one agent in one batch share it

pkHash.description: sha256(publicKey); must be an authorized key of agentId in AgentRegistry

side.description: buy = spend quote for base (flags 1); sell = sell base for quote (flags 0)

orderBytes.description: flags u8 | amountIn u96 | minAmountOut u96

signature.description: ML-DSA-65 signature (3309 bytes), FIPS 204, empty context
